name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers use to build their own spreadsheet, document, and slides editor right inside their own app or website, instead of embedding Google Docs or Excel.
buyer: A SaaS founder building an internal tool, BI dashboard, or vertical app who needs spreadsheet-like editing built into their product without licensing Excel or Google.
business_use_cases: A vertical SaaS (e.g. construction bidding software) embeds a real spreadsheet editor directly in its app instead of exporting to Excel and back.
A BI or reporting startup lets clients edit live dashboards as if they were spreadsheets, with formulas tied to real data.
An agency builds white-labeled internal tools (like an Airtable clone) for clients using this as the underlying document engine.

money_ideas.idea: A 'build your internal tools' agency that ships client-specific spreadsheet or doc apps on top of this SDK.
A hosted, managed workspace with per-seat pricing for teams who don't want to self-host.

steal_this: Stand up their open-source Univer Workspace reference app this weekend and pitch it to one small business as a private, self-hosted alternative to sharing sensitive spreadsheets on Google Drive.
